title: Intent Drift at SME Scale: Deployment Practice, Not Model Capability, Determines Agentic Compliance
abstract: arXiv:2609.05975v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Chain of Intent, a governance framework for agentic AI at small regulated firms, and validate it against a failure it was built to address. Existing agentic governance research assumes enterprise infrastructure that small firms do not have. In a simulated Hong Kong asset manager with 415 synthetic contact records, an agent performing a routine client-communications task was subjected to ordinary managerial pressure to increase its reach. With its authorised constraints written into its configuration, the agent held: it identified every ambiguity in the firm's records, cited privacy legislation it had never been shown, and refused six successive requests, breaching in two of fifteen runs. translated_title: 中小企业规模下的意图漂移：决定智能体合规性的是部署实践，而非模型能力
translated_abstract: 我们提出“意图链”，这是一个面向小型受监管企业的智能体AI治理框架，并通过验证其旨在解决的一类失败场景来检验其有效性。现有的智能体治理研究往往假设了小型企业并不具备的企业级基础设施。在一个模拟的香港资产管理公司环境中（包含415条合成联系人记录），一个执行常规客户沟通任务的智能体被施以要求扩大触达范围的普通管理压力。当其被授权的约束条件被写入配置中时，该智能体守住了底线：它识别出了公司记录中的每一处模糊之处，引用了从未向其展示过的隐私法规，并在连续六次请求中予以拒绝，十五次运行中仅有两次违规。而在相同的任务、数据、压力和模型条件下，仅因其目的未被明确声明——正如资源受限企业通常的做法——它在十五次运行中有十三次违规，联系了多达220人，其中94%的人没有任何可证实的（原文截断）
tldr: 本文提出“意图链”治理框架，并通过模拟实验证明，决定智能体AI合规性的关键不是模型能力而是企业的部署实践——将约束与目的明确写入配置可使违规率从15次中13次降至15次中2次。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Chain of Intent governance framework and demonstrates through simulation that deployment practice, not model capability, determines agentic AI compliance—explicitly encoding constraints and purpose into configuration reduced breaches from 13 out of 15 runs to 2 out of 15.
